title: Bundle-size build probe
description: Per-artifact byte-count summary of the build/ subdirectories whose contents ship into the Resecta engine. Engineer-facing only -- no Resecta UI surface in V1; feeds V1.1+ cold-start threshold decisions. The engine_load_ms / first_detection_ready_ms Swift metrics are the companion cold-start half and ship from the Mac side.

_meta.description: Body-side metadata. The build-input git HEAD lives in the sibling `bundle_size.meta.json` sidecar and is excluded from the hash lock so this artifact stays byte-stable across lockfile-regen cycles.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version. V1.1+ may bump.

subdirectories.description: Per-subdirectory summary. Keys are subdirectory names under build/; values are the size payload. Subdirectories that do not exist on the host emit an empty payload (file_count=0, files=[], total_bytes=0) so the schema stays stable across hosts. The Swift-produced build/calibration/ tree is intentionally excluded from the default walk (a hand-review surface; not built by this pipeline; not shipped into the app).

total_build_size.description: Sum of total_bytes across all walked subdirectories, in bytes.

sha256_short.description: First 12 hex chars of the file's SHA-256, for cross-reference with asset_hashes.lock (which carries the full digest).
